build_efficientformer_backbone: build an EfficientFormer backbone model with arch l1 for image classification
build_efficientformer_downstream: build an EfficientFormer l3 backbone with out_indices 0 1 2 3 for downstream tasks
create_attention_with_bias: create an AttentionWithBias module with custom embed_dims and resolution for spatial attention

create_meta4d_block: create a Meta4D pooling block with conv MLP for 4D tensor feature extraction
